objectives: Use diagnostic evidence to target a weak /d/ component.
Provide focused practice for sound recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, or fluency.
Reassess with fresh items after remediation.
Advance only when mastery criteria are met.
concepts: Remediation should match the observed weak component.
Mastery requires both adequate performance and no critical weak component.

definitions.definition: Focused instruction and practice for an identified weak skill.
A new measurement after remediation to determine whether the skill is secure.
An assessment item not previously used for the learner's earlier diagnostic.

workedExamples: Weak decoding → segment and blend new /d/ CVC words.
Weak encoding → dictate new /d/ CVC words and map phonemes.
Weak comprehension → reread controlled text and locate evidence.
Weak fluency → accurate repeated reading of fresh controlled text.
commonMistakes: Remediating every skill when only one is weak.
Advancing despite a critical component below target.

conceptual: Match an error pattern to the correct remediation component.
higherOrderThinking: Explain why fresh items are required for reassessment.
mixedReview: Review all /d/ components before final routing.

formulaOrFactBank: Advance when reassessment ≥0.80 and no critical component is below target.
mistakeBasedRevision: Reteach the exact component linked to the error.
weakTopicRevision: Use a short focused cycle, then reassess with new items.

activities.name: Feedback loop
steps: Schedule another fresh reassessment when needed.

outcomes: Learner demonstrates improvement using fresh assessment items.
System advances learners who meet mastery criteria.
System routes learners below mastery to further targeted reteaching.

routing.advance: Advance when reassessment is at least 0.80 and no critical component is below target.
routing.reteach: Reteach only the component(s) below 0.80 and reassess with fresh items.

questions.question: Which sound is the focus of this reassessment?
Read: “A dog is big.” What is big?
Which action best remediates weak decoding?
options: Segment and blend fresh CVC words.

questions.question: Which action best remediates weak encoding?
options: Dictate fresh CVC words and map phonemes.

questions.question: What should happen after targeted practice?
When should the learner advance?
options: At least 0.80 with no critical weak component.

questions.question: What should happen if a component remains below 0.80?
options: Reteach that component and reassess with fresh items.
